# 1. Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Signac)
  library(Seurat)
  library(monocle3)
  library(monocle)
  library(cicero)
  library(scuttle)
  library(Matrix)
  library(dplyr)
  library(Biobase)
  library(VGAM)
})

SCRIPT_DIR <- getwd()   
PROJECT_ROOT <- file.path(SCRIPT_DIR, "..")                     
DATA_DIR      <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "data")

output_dir   <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "output", "feature_scores", "cicero")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# 2. Parameters/Inputs
```{r}
seurat_file  <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "seo_RNA_ATAC_chr123.rds")
celltype_tsv <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "celltypes.tsv")
genome_sizes <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "hg38.chrom.sizes")

celltype_col <- "cell_type_manual"
leiden_col   <- "leiden"
```

# 3. Main Function
```{r}
run_one_celltype <- function(obj_all, celltype_key, genome_sizes, output_dir) {
  cat("\n===== Running:", celltype_key, "=====\n")
  sel <- obj_all[[celltype_col]] == trimws(celltype_key)
  if (!any(sel)) {
    cat("No cells found — skipping.\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  obj <- obj_all[, sel]
  
  # ATAC -> cluster matrix
  atac <- suppressWarnings(SeuratObject::GetAssayData(obj, assay = "ATAC", layer = "data"))
  cluster_ids <- obj[[leiden_col]][, 1, drop = TRUE]
  meta_counts <- scuttle::sumCountsAcrossCells(atac, cluster_ids)
  expr_mat <- 1L * (SummarizedExperiment::assay(meta_counts, "sum") > 0)
  
  # valid peaks
  peak_names <- rownames(expr_mat)
  valid <- grepl("^chr[^:]+[-:]\\d+[-:]\\d+$", peak_names)
  expr_mat <- expr_mat[valid, , drop = FALSE]
  dash_names <- gsub(":", "-", rownames(expr_mat))
  rownames(expr_mat) <- dash_names
  parsed_coords <- strcapture(
    "^chr(\\w+)-(\\d+)-(\\d+)$",
    dash_names,
    data.frame(chr = character(), bp1 = integer(), bp2 = integer(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  )
  rownames(parsed_coords) <- dash_names
  
  # monocle3 CDS
  cellinfo <- data.frame(cells = colnames(expr_mat), row.names = colnames(expr_mat))
  peakinfo <- data.frame(peaks = dash_names, gene_short_name = dash_names, row.names = dash_names)
  cds <- monocle3::new_cell_data_set(expr_mat, cell_metadata = cellinfo, gene_metadata = peakinfo)
  cds <- cds[Matrix::rowSums(SummarizedExperiment::assay(cds, "counts")) != 0, ]
  parsed_coords_aligned <- parsed_coords[rownames(cds), , drop = FALSE]
  cds <- monocle3::detect_genes(cds)
  cds <- monocle3::estimate_size_factors(cds)
  cds <- monocle3::preprocess_cds(cds, method = "LSI")
  cds <- monocle3::reduce_dimension(cds, reduction_method = "UMAP", preprocess_method = "LSI")
  
  # harmonize chr names
  rd <- as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::rowData(cds))
  rd <- cbind(rd, parsed_coords_aligned)
  chrlen <- read.table(genome_sizes, col.names = c("chr","length"))
  chr_has_chr <- any(grepl("^chr", chrlen$chr))
  rd_has_chr  <- any(grepl("^chr", rd$chr))
  if (chr_has_chr && !rd_has_chr) {
    rd$chr <- paste0("chr", rd$chr)
  } else if (!chr_has_chr && rd_has_chr) {
    rd$chr <- sub("^chr", "", rd$chr)
  }
  SummarizedExperiment::rowData(cds) <- rd
  
  # monocle v2 CDS for cicero
  fd <- new("AnnotatedDataFrame", data = as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::rowData(cds)))
  pd <- new("AnnotatedDataFrame", data = as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::colData(cds)))
  cicero_cds <- monocle::newCellDataSet(
    SummarizedExperiment::assay(cds, "counts"),
    phenoData = pd,
    featureData = fd,
    expressionFamily = VGAM::binomialff(),
    lowerDetectionLimit = 0
  )
  umap <- SingleCellExperiment::reducedDims(cds)$UMAP
  monocle::reducedDimA(cicero_cds) <- as.matrix(umap[colnames(cicero_cds), , drop = FALSE])
  
  # normalize exprs
  cicero_cds <- monocle::detectGenes(cicero_cds, min_expr = 0.1)
  cicero_cds <- cicero:::estimateSizeFactorsSimp(cicero_cds)
  sf  <- Biobase::pData(cicero_cds)$Size_Factor
  mat <- Biobase::exprs(cicero_cds)
  mat_norm <- Matrix::t(Matrix::t(mat) / sf)
  Biobase::exprs(cicero_cds) <- as.matrix(mat_norm)
  
  # run cicero
  conns <- cicero::run_cicero(cicero_cds, genomic_coords = chrlen)
  cat("Connections:", nrow(conns), "\n")
  
  # save
  if (nrow(conns) > 0) {
    out_file <- file.path(output_dir, paste0("cicero_connections_", celltype_key, ".tsv"))
    write.table(conns[, c("Peak1", "Peak2", "coaccess")], out_file, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
    cat("Saved:", out_file, "\n")
  }
}
```

# 4. Run Main
```{r}
df <- read.delim(celltype_tsv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
df$celltype_key <- trimws(df$celltype_key)
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cat("Loading Seurat object once...\n")
obj_all <- readRDS(seurat_file)

for (celltype_key in df$celltype_key) {
  tryCatch({
    run_one_celltype(obj_all, celltype_key, genome_sizes, output_dir)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("ERROR in ", celltype_key, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
  })
}

cat("All done.\n")
```
